svg.title: Four skills of divergent thinking: fluency, flexibility, originality, elaboration
svg.desc: One large triangle split into four. Top corner, fluency: a dense burst of many identical small gold triangles. Left corner, flexibility: small triangles pointing out in six directions, each spoke a different colour. Right corner, originality: a field of identical violet triangles with one coral triangle turned the other way and set apart. Inverted centre, elaboration: a triangle subdivided again and again into finer triangles. Original course diagram after Chen (2011, 26).
